name: Inn Another World
source: This is a hand drawn Visual Novel/Dating Sim game, where you run an Inn in, you guessed it, another world. Thrown into an unfamiliar world, you must survive and manage your inn while learning about this new world you find yourself in.
translation: 这是一款手绘风格的视觉小说／恋爱模拟游戏，你将在一个异世界经营旅店，没错，就是异世界。被抛入陌生世界后，你必须一边求生、一边管理旅店，同时了解自己身处的新世界。
